description: Flutter student-side 2-way additions (non-breaking). Adds the optional Trainer Referral Code field to registration, the link-after-register call with invalid-code surfacing on the verify-email screen (the register screen is torn down by the auth redirect), a 'Trainer Login' action reusing the same Firebase auth, and the student 'My Trainer' card + progress-photo sharing toggle in the profile screen. All additive — existing auth and profile flows keep working. Depends on FEAT-002 (link-trainer endpoint, /api/student/trainer) and shares auth files with FEAT-003, so it runs after FEAT-003 to avoid index/staging races.
steps: Repository + provider (design §6.4): in frontend/lib/features/auth/data/auth_repository.dart add linkTrainer(code) hitting POST /api/auth/link-trainer and a LinkTrainerResult type, plus a linkTrainerResultProvider (StateProvider<LinkTrainerResult?>) written via a container/notifier that OUTLIVES the register screen (design-review NIT 4), not via a possibly-disposed WidgetRef.

Register (design §2.1, §6.4): in frontend/lib/features/auth/presentation/register_screen.dart add ONE optional TextFormField with placeholder exactly 'Enter trainer referral code (optional)' and no blocking validator; if non-empty, call authRepository.linkTrainer(code) right after a successful register() (route needs only authenticate, works pre-verification); empty field -> skip the link call entirely.

Verify-email surfacing (design §6.4): in frontend/lib/features/auth/presentation/verify_email_screen.dart read linkTrainerResultProvider and surface the outcome on this (mounted) screen: {linked:false, reason:'invalid_code'} -> 'Invalid trainer referral code' (non-blocking; account still a student); {linked:true} -> 'Connected to Dream Physics'; clear the provider once shown.

Trainer Login (design §6.4): in frontend/lib/features/auth/presentation/login_screen.dart add a clear secondary 'Trainer Login' action that uses the SAME Firebase email/password sign-in (existing authController.login); role is resolved by the backend post-login and the router routes to the trainer shell. No separate credential path, no client-side role decision.

My Trainer card (design §6.4, requirement 7): in frontend/lib/features/profile/presentation/profile_screen.dart add an additive 'My Trainer' section showing trainer name/photo/status from GET /api/student/trainer (unlinked -> no-trainer/invite state) plus the shareProgressWithTrainer toggle (PATCH /api/student/trainer/sharing). Example copy: 'Your Trainer — Dream Physics — Referral Code: dreamphysics'.

Test: add frontend/test/register_referral_test.dart asserting an invalid code shows the message and the user still lands as a student (via overridden auth repository/provider). Follow the existing *_test.dart style.
acceptance_criteria: Registration keeps Name/Email/Password/Confirm plus ONE optional field with placeholder exactly 'Enter trainer referral code (optional)'; empty code gives the normal student experience with no link.

Code 'dreamphysics' links the student (visible via the My Trainer card) and the account is still a full student; an invalid code shows 'Invalid trainer referral code' on the verify-email screen and the account is still created as a student.
'Trainer Login' uses the existing Firebase email/password auth (no separate auth system) and relies on backend-resolved role for routing.
A linked student sees 'My Trainer' with name/photo/status and can toggle progress-photo sharing; an unlinked student sees a no-trainer state.
flutter analyze is clean, flutter test passes including register_referral_test.dart, and flutter build apk --debug succeeds.
findings:
DONE. Verification GREEN in frontend/: flutter analyze (No issues found), flutter test (108 passed = 104 prior + 4 new in register_referral_test.dart), flutter build apk --debug (built build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk).

REGISTER REFERRAL FLOW:
- register_screen.dart: added ONE optional TextFormField (controller _referral) with decoration hintText EXACTLY 'Enter trainer referral code (optional)' (labelText 'Trainer referral code', card_giftcard icon), NO validator (never blocks submit). The previous last field (Confirm password) changed textInputAction done->next and dropped its onFieldSubmitted so the referral field is now the done/submit field. _submit() now awaits register() and, only on success AND non-empty trimmed code, fires ref.read(linkTrainerControllerProvider.notifier).link(code). Empty field => link skipped entirely (normal independent student).
- The link is intentionally NOT awaited by the screen: the auth redirect tears the register screen down the instant register() succeeds (user -> verify-email). The request is OWNED by linkTrainerControllerProvider.

LINK CONTROLLER / PROVIDER (lives in auth_controller.dart, next to authControllerProvider):
- class LinkTrainerController extends StateNotifier<LinkTrainerResult?> holding an AuthRepository reference (NOT a WidgetRef). link(code) trims (empty -> no-op), calls repo.linkTrainer, stores the result; a transport failure degrades to LinkTrainerResult(linked:false, reason:'error') so registration is never blocked. consume() reads+clears (surface-once).
- final linkTrainerControllerProvider = StateNotifierProvider<LinkTrainerController, LinkTrainerResult?>; it is a ROOT-container provider so it OUTLIVES the disposed register screen (design-review NIT 4 satisfied). Note: this is the provider FEAT-003's findings said FEAT-004 would add. It reuses the existing AuthRepository.linkTrainer (added by FEAT-003) which POSTs /api/auth/link-trainer (FEAT-002's endpoint). I did NOT touch AuthRepository.linkTrainer / LinkTrainerResult / AccountInfo.role — all preexisting from FEAT-002/003.

VERIFY-EMAIL SURFACING (verify_email_screen.dart):
- Added _surfaceLinkResult(LinkTrainerResult?): {linked:true} -> SnackBar 'Connected to <trainerName|your trainer>' (e.g. 'Connected to Dream Physics'); {linked:false, reason:'invalid_code'} -> 'Invalid trainer referral code' (non-blocking; account stays a student); any other soft failure (reason:'error') -> "Couldn't verify the referral code. You can add it later.". After showing, calls consume() so it fires exactly once.
- Surfaced TWO ways to beat the link-call-vs-redirect race: a post-frame callback in initState (result already settled before the screen mounted) AND ref.listen(linkTrainerControllerProvider) in build (result lands after mount). Both route through _surfaceLinkResult, which no-ops when the value is null/consumed, so no double SnackBar.

TRAINER LOGIN (login_screen.dart):
- Added a secondary OutlinedButton.icon 'Trainer Login' that calls the SAME _submit() (existing authController.login = Firebase email/password). Explicitly NO separate credential path and NO client-side role decision: the backend resolves role on /api/auth/verify and app_router.dart (FEAT-003) routes a trainer to the trainer shell. Added helper caption 'Trainers sign in with the same email and password.'.

MY TRAINER CARD + SHARING TOGGLE (profile_screen.dart):
- New additive section 'MY TRAINER' (SectionHeader + _MyTrainerSection ConsumerStatefulWidget) inserted BEFORE the ACCOUNT section. Reads myTrainerProvider (GET /api/student/trainer): unlinked -> 'No trainer connected' invite tile; linked -> trainer avatar/photo + 'Your Trainer' + name + 'Referral Code: <code>' + a Connected/status chip. Loading/error tiles handled (error tile tap re-invalidates).
- Progress-sharing Switch: initial value from profile.shareProgressWithTrainer; onChanged optimistically flips, PATCHes /api/student/trainer/sharing via trainerRepository.setSharing, on success invalidates profileProvider, on failure reverts + SnackBar.

SHARED-FILE ADDITIONS (so integration/other steps don't clobber):
- trainer_models.dart: added class MyTrainer (linked flag + trainerId/name/photoUrl/referralCode/status/associationStatus; MyTrainer.none; fromJson maps {trainer:null} -> none).
- trainer_repository.dart: added myTrainer() -> Result<MyTrainer> (GET /api/student/trainer) and setSharing(bool) -> Result<bool> (PATCH /api/student/trainer/sharing, reads back json['shareProgressWithTrainer']).
- trainer_providers.dart: added myTrainerProvider (FutureProvider<MyTrainer>).
- models/user_profile.dart: added `final bool shareProgressWithTrainer` (default false) to ctor/copyWith/props and fromJson (json['shareProgressWithTrainer'] ?? false). Deliberately NOT added to toUpsertJson — the flag is owned by the dedicated PATCH /api/student/trainer/sharing endpoint and the profile upsert uses merge:true, so omitting it never clears it. The existing user_profile_test.dart still passes.

TESTS: frontend/test/register_referral_test.dart (4 cases): invalid code -> 'Invalid trainer referral code' shown + NOT linked (consumed) + account stays student; valid 'dreamphysics' -> 'Connected to Dream Physics'; empty/whitespace code -> backend never called; transport failure -> soft linked:false (still a student). Uses a fake AuthRepository (implements linkTrainer + noSuchMethod) and pumps VerifyEmailScreen directly (the full-router register path is covered indirectly by the existing routing tests). Follows the existing *_test.dart style.

NO REGRESSIONS: existing auth/profile flows unchanged; AccountInfo/role, app_router role branch, HomeShell all untouched. The 104 prior tests still pass.

GIT: unlike the repo root (not a git repo), git DOES work from frontend/ — it is a SEPARATE repo rooted at frontend/ on branch feat/trainer-student-2way. Committed FEAT-004 locally (NOT pushed) as 51ae571 'feat: student-side trainer referral + My Trainer card (FEAT-004)', 10 files staged by explicit path: lib/features/auth/providers/auth_controller.dart, lib/features/auth/presentation/{register_screen.dart,verify_email_screen.dart,login_screen.dart}, lib/features/trainer/data/{trainer_models.dart,trainer_repository.dart}, lib/features/trainer/providers/trainer_providers.dart, lib/features/profile/presentation/profile_screen.dart, lib/models/user_profile.dart, test/register_referral_test.dart.
